## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A seven-juan supplement to [慧洪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%B4%AA) Huìhóng's *Chánlín sēngbǎo zhuàn* ([KR6q0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0040)), by the Southern Sòng monk Zǔxiù. Adds biographies of further Chán masters from the Northern Sòng to the early Southern Sòng, in continuation of Huìhóng's biographical method.

**Abstract**

Zǔxiù — the same Zǔxiù who compiled the *Lóngxīng biānnián tōnglùn* [隆興編年通論](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Titles/%E9%9A%86%E8%88%88%E7%B7%A8%E5%B9%B4%E9%80%9A%E8%AB%96) of 1164 — extends Huìhóng's biographical compendium with later figures, particularly from the Yángqí 楊岐 line whose ascendancy in the early Southern Sòng was already evident. The work preserves Huìhóng's literary-narrative format and is treated as the canonical second member of the three-part *Sēngbǎo zhuàn* sub-tradition ([KR6q0040](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0040) + [KR6q0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0041) + [KR6q0042](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0042)).
